Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

regain verb

also recover (get back), get back, win back, retrieve

classical

Cic. Mur. 50: quī ērepta recuperāre vellet (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 7.15.2 (Lewis & Short)

recuperō (reciperō), recuperāre, recuperāvī, recuperātum

verb, first conjugation

get back, regain, recover

Other words

  • recuperātor (reciperātor), recuperātōris m. — one who regains; in law, in the plural, a board of three or five judges

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Tac. Ann. 2.52 (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • quī ērepta recuperāre vellet

    a man who wanted to get back what had been taken from himCic. Mur. 50 (Lewis & Short)

  • urbis recuperātor

    the man who won back the cityTac. Ann. 2.52 (Lewis & Short)

See also lose, find.
